task.description:
Validate the CODE-DESIGNER output for EPIC-3 (ISS-301, ISS-302, ISS-303) before BACKEND-DEV begins implementation.

Verify:
1. ISS-301: Removal of pg_try_advisory_xact_lock is justified; SKIP LOCKED rationale is sound; no double-firing risk documented
2. ISS-302: Startup lock protocol uses session-level lock (pg_try_advisory_lock, not xact); acquire before sweep, release after; non-holder skips sweep and goes to poll; lock ID is a fixed constant
3. ISS-303: Migration adds fire_error_count and failed_at; atomicity guaranteed (UPDATE+DLQ INSERT in same transaction); DLQ INSERT SQL fields are correct (item_type, source_ref, instance_id match DlqItemType.TIMER)
4. No implementation code present
5. Error handling and rollback semantics documented for each change
6. Test strategy covers both unit and integration scenarios
acceptance_criteria: ISS-302 lock protocol uses session-level advisory lock correctly
Test strategy is concrete and testable

result.summary: Design artefact scheduler-concurrency-epic3.md validated — all acceptance criteria covered for ISS-301, ISS-302, ISS-303
